scope: The current verification route targets the October main theorem. An exact literal refutation would be an alternative campaign route.

C9000307.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 307 (Failure of rational injectivity for maximal coarse assembly.; papers: Failure of rational injectivity for maximal coarse assembly; A counterexample to the coarse Novikov conjecture; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/307.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

OCT_MAIN.statement: October thm:main: an infinite-order maximal coarse assembly kernel class exists.

OCT_GEOMETRY.statement: Uniform bounded geometry, eventual word-ball injectivity, and torus interpolation.

OCT_CHERN.statement: For fixed r and all sufficiently large j, the integral pulled-back first Chern class is divisible by 2^j.

OCT_K.statement: For a fixed uniform dimension bound D_r, the odd K-class is integrally divisible by 2^(j-floor(log2 D_r)) eventually in j.

OCT_COMPONENT.statement: For every fixed r>=3 and fixed n!=0, the n-fold endpoint difference is nonzero for all sufficiently large j.

OCT_INFINITE.statement: The topological endpoint class has infinite order in the Rips colimit.

OCT_TRANSFER_MAX.statement: October ana:transfer: the maximal Roe projection has a K-theory splitting.

OCT_ENDPOINTS_MAX.statement: October ana:endpoints: the two maximal analytic endpoint composites agree.

OCT_NATURALITY_MAX.statement: Fixed-propagation maximal norm control, the compact ideal, multipliers, and maximal assembly naturality.

C_CP.statement: Parameter-uniform verification of the congruence-to-integral-persistence implication, with explicit thresholds and no maximal-index conclusion.

C_CP_ALG.statement: Universal noncentral cancellation, integral cochain lift, dyadic binomial and nilpotent-ring divisibility, and endpoint pairing obstruction.

C_CP_NONCENTRAL.statement: For every j>=1 the congruence kernel is not central in arbitrary fiber lifts; this excludes an unused shortcut, not a manuscript assertion.

SEP_MAIN.statement: September thm:main concerns an infinite-order REDUCED coarse assembly kernel class, using a separate disc construction.

SEP_SMALLLOOPS.statement: September lem:trace and lem:smallloops separate every fixed bound in sufficiently late components.

SEP_PERSISTENCE.statement: September prop:persistence constructs an integer detector at each fixed Rips scale.

SEP_TRANSFER.statement: September prop:transfer gives a reduced locally compact Roe homomorphism under uniform fiber averaging and controlled transport.

SEP_VANISH.statement: September filled-disc vanishing and the operator factorization imply zero reduced coarse index.
